sar.narrative: Customer C05851, holder of card C05851-K1, is the subject of this report following a monitoring alert for structuring. Between 2016-11-21 10:00 and 2016-11-21 10:30, four online purchases totaling $1,911.84 were executed on card C05851-K1 within thirty minutes. These transactions included amounts of $459.27 on transaction 3475403 at 10:00, $496.35 on transaction 3475405 at 10:08, $468.22 on transaction 3475408 at 10:22, and $488.00 on transaction 3475414 at 10:30. The activity is suspicious because every amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold and placed minutes apart. Furthermore, the $468.22 purchase is well above the card's 95th percentile of $250.00 compared to its median of $56.49, and product code C was never used on this card before. The transactions originated from device profile 'C6743 Build/LMY47V | Android 5.1.1 | android browser 4.0 | 960x540', which had been used on the card for one prior transaction. Although the case-memory model score was 0.059 and the bank risk score was 0.07, eight of the eight most similar closed cases—specifically CC-3841, CC-4124, CC-4086, and CC-3748—were confirmed fraud with an exposure of $1,911.84 under verdict fraud and pattern undocumented. In response, the bank has executed a case creation and analyst escalation, while recommending a card block and filing report awaiting human approval.
